scripts.check: npm run type && npm run lint
scripts.docs: npm run build && cd website && npm run start
scripts.build: npm run clean && cd packages/plugin && tsup && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.json --outDir lib && cp src/components/styles.css lib/components/styles.css
scripts.pack: npm run build && cd packages/plugin && npm pack
scripts.release: npm run pack && npm run check && lerna-release
